propositions: Pandoc 3.6.1 silently corrupts wiki output by escaping punctuation inside code spans, deleting HTML comments, and rewriting arrow delimiters in comment terminators
A two-phase lexer must lock code spans, HTML comments, fences, and indented blocks before classification to prevent pandoc from corrupting protected content

An inline-Jira classifier must recognize balanced markup forms (bold, italic, link, color, monospace) and pass them exactly only when all delimiters are consumed and no CommonMark-only syntax is present
ASCII tables with pipe-bearing lines must be wrapped exactly once in {noformat} and preserve byte-identical content across conversion
A post-render code-preservation check must verify every source code fragment appears verbatim in output, else fall back to original Markdown for that unit

Missing pypandoc or conversion/preservation failures must return the original unit and log only content-free wiki_render_fallback events with reason pandoc_absent, conversion_failure, or preservation_failure
